title: Leaving Egypt — A Christ-Centered Brotherhood for Men

hero.title:
Leave the bondage.
Walk in freedom.
Lead with purpose.
hero.lede: Leaving Egypt helps men face what has kept them stuck, strengthen what matters most, and move forward following Christ—together, not alone.

recognition.title: You may look strong on the outside while something inside still needs to change.
recognition.lede: There's no shame in admitting it. Most men carry more than they let on. Naming it honestly is where real change begins.
items: You go through the motions spiritually, but it feels distant.
You carry mistakes you've never fully put down.
You look connected, yet you feel alone.
You're physically or mentally running on empty.
You're home in body but not always in heart.
You work hard, but peace and clarity are hard to find.

mission.title: Stop surviving. Start living the life God designed.
mission.body: Leaving Egypt is a Christ-centered men's organization dedicated to helping men leave behind the bondage of their past and step into the freedom, purpose, and identity God has called them to. Through biblical teaching, authentic brotherhood, practical challenges, and intentional growth in Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance, we equip men to become stronger husbands, fathers, leaders, and followers of Christ.

pillars.title: Four pillars, one whole man
pillars.lede: Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance hold each other up. They aren't a scorecard for your worth—they're areas where steady growth changes everyday life.

cards.title: Faith
cards.description: Move from knowing about God to walking with Him. Build steady habits of prayer, Scripture, and worship so your faith shapes ordinary days—not just Sundays.

cards.title: Family
cards.description: Show up as a husband, father, and son others can count on. Learn to be present, patient, and trustworthy in the relationships closest to you.

cards.title: Fitness
cards.description: Care for the body God gave you with steady, sustainable discipline. This is about health and stewardship, not appearance or comparison.

cards.title: Finance
cards.description: Handle work and money with wisdom, honesty, and generosity. Stewardship over striving—no promises of wealth, just a healthier relationship with what you manage.

journey.title: A path out of what holds you
journey.lede: It isn't a program you finish. It's a direction you keep walking—one honest step at a time.

steps.title: Recognize what holds you
steps.body: Freedom starts with honesty. We help you name the patterns, wounds, and habits that have quietly kept you stuck—without shame, and without pretending.

steps.title: Renew your identity
steps.body: You are not your worst moments. Ground your sense of who you are in what God says about you, and let that reshape how you think and live.

steps.title: Rebuild with brotherhood
steps.body: Change rarely sticks alone. Walk with other men who tell the truth, cheer you on, and hold you to the commitments you make.

steps.title: Walk forward with purpose
steps.body: Take real steps in Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance—small, consistent, and lived out where it actually counts.

brotherhood.eyebrow: Not meant to be done alone
brotherhood.title: Change sticks when you're not the only one carrying it
brotherhood.body:
Most men have plenty of acquaintances and very few real friendships. Leaving Egypt is built on brotherhood—men who choose honesty over image, encouragement over comparison, and follow-through over good intentions.

Together we practice telling the truth, spurring each other on, holding one another accountable, and taking real action rooted in Scripture. As Proverbs 27:17 puts it, iron sharpens iron.

outcomes.title: Real, ordinary progress
outcomes.lede: We don't promise outcomes. Every man's story and pace are different. But here are the kinds of changes men often hope to grow toward:
items: Greater consistency in prayer and Scripture
Friendships built on truth, not performance
A steadier sense of who you are in Christ
outcomes.disclaimer: Your journey and your results are your own. Nothing here is a guarantee—just honest work, walked out over time.

engage.title: Find the on-ramp that fits
engage.lede: These are the paths we're building. Specific formats, schedules, and details are being finalized—reach out and we'll tell you what's open now.

cards.title: Brotherhood Groups
cards.body: Small circles of men who meet to be honest, encourage one another, and grow together.

cards.title: Biblical Growth Experiences
cards.body: Guided teaching that connects Scripture to the real decisions of everyday life.

cards.title: Practical Challenges
cards.body: Simple, concrete steps that turn good intentions into steady action.

cards.title: Events & Retreats
cards.body: Set-apart time to step back, refocus, and reconnect with God and other men.

cards.title: Mentorship & Coaching
cards.body: One-to-one guidance for men who want a steadier hand alongside them.

cards.title: Resources & Teaching
cards.body: Articles, reflections, and tools you can use on your own or with a group.

sofTeaser.title: Rooted in Christ, open to men at every stage
sofTeaser.body: Leaving Egypt is built on historic, Christ-centered Christian faith—the good news of Jesus, the authority of Scripture, and salvation by grace through faith. You don't have to have it all sorted out to be welcome here.
sofTeaser.cta: Read the full Statement of Faith

items.question: What is Leaving Egypt?
items.answer: Leaving Egypt is a Christ-centered men's organization and brotherhood. We help men leave behind what has held them back and grow in Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance through biblical teaching, honest community, and practical steps.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Adult men at any stage of faith—whether you feel far from God, newly serious about following Him, or simply worn down and ready for something steadier. You don't need to have it all figured out.

items.question: Do I need to be a business owner?
items.answer: No. Leaving Egypt is for men from every walk of life. The finance pillar is about wise stewardship and integrity, not running a company or building wealth.

items.question: Is Leaving Egypt a church?
items.answer: No. We're a brotherhood that walks alongside men. We encourage every man to be part of a local church—we come alongside that, we don't replace it.

items.question: Is there a cost to get involved?
items.answer: Program details, including any cost, are being confirmed. Reach out and we'll share what's currently available.

finalCta.title: You don't have to stay where you are
finalCta.lede: One honest step is enough to begin. Tell us where you'd like to grow, and we'll walk with you from there.
